title: StructureGen structural database
description: The file format StructureGen reads section data from. Point your editor at this schema to get completion and validation while editing a database by hand. StructureGen validates far more than this schema can express - cross-references, per-category required dimensions and geometric plausibility - so a file that satisfies this schema may still be reported as invalid on load, with a message naming the record.

schemaVersion.description: The format version. This build reads major version 1. A newer minor version is accepted because minor revisions only add optional fields.

database.description: Identity and provenance of the dataset. Recorded on generated objects so a drawing states which data revision it was built from.

units.description: The units the numbers in THIS file are written in. Declared once; every value is converted to millimetres and kilograms on load.

standards.description: The standards this file's sections belong to. May be omitted, in which case a shared standards.json in the same folder is used.

materials.description: Materials, and their densities where known. A density is what allows a weight to be derived for a profile with no tabulated mass per metre. Omitting it is honest: StructureGen then reports the weight as unavailable rather than estimating one.

id.description: Unique within the file. Written onto every object generated from this record, so changing it orphans existing drawings.

category.description: Which generator draws this profile. A category with no registered generator can still be scheduled but not drawn.

material.description: A material id, or a material name to match by.

unitWeight.description: Mass per length, in this file's unitWeight unit. Preferred over deriving a weight from geometry.

pieceMass.description: Mass per piece, in this file's pieceMass unit. Used for fasteners.

dimensions.description: Cross-sectional dimensions in this file's length unit, keyed by the vocabulary in docs/DATABASE.md. The key 'A' is an area and converts by the square of the length factor.

properties.description: Additional tabulated values such as second moments of area. Stored verbatim, never converted, and informational only.

outline.description: An explicit closed cross-section outline, in this file's length unit. Lets a database introduce a profile no built-in generator covers.

bulge.description: Tangent of a quarter of the arc's included angle for the segment leaving this vertex. Zero is a straight segment; positive turns anticlockwise.

verified.description: Set true only once you have checked the record against your authoritative source. Unverified records are flagged in the palette, on the bill of materials and in the exported workbook.
